metadata.title: Urban Street Portrait with Distressed Stencil Type

retrievalProfile.description: A gritty urban portrait featuring a close-up subject in camouflage against a desaturated brick background with oversized, textured stencil lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-angle portrait of a man in a camouflage jacket and beanie, positioned in the foreground. The background features a desaturated, slightly grainy residential brick building with secondary figures. A large, vibrant orange title with a rough, hand-painted stencil texture dominates the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject scale vs. background architectural depth
Vibrant orange typography vs. desaturated background tones
Organic camouflage patterns vs. geometric brick grid
Direct eye contact vs. candid background activity

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is large-scale, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large orange stencil text in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright orange text to the subject's eyes, down the arm to the clenched fist, then into the background figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with architectural detail and figures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greys and browns in the background architecture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted greens and tans of the camouflage jacket.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant, high-saturation orange for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright sky/text and the dark shadows of the brickwork.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary blues or reds

letterConstructionRules: Thick, uneven strokes resembling paint applied with a sponge or rough brush
Visible 'splatter' and 'drip' artifacts around the edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Periods or dots rendered as irregular, textured blobs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face paired with standard utilitarian metadata blocks.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rough, hand-painted stencil aesthetic.
Provides the heavy, distressed block feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle urban portrait of a man in a camo jacket and beanie in front of a desaturated brick apartment building with people in the distance.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, textured orange stencil lettering in the top left corner, ensuring the edges look like rough paint.

verificationChecks: Is the orange text sufficiently distressed?

Is the subject's camo pattern clearly visible?
